item.title: The Battle to Bring Green Steel to Market
item.description: Many countries around the globe are rapidly ramping up their renewable energy capacity and moving away from fossil fuels in a bid to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions. However, decarbonising certain sectors, such as heavy industry, is not so simple. Various companies worldwide are searching for ways to decarbonise the steel industry, with little luck to date. item.title: OPEC+ Approves Modest Output Hike as Iran War Jolts Oil Markets
item.description: OPEC+ agreed on Sunday to raise oil output by a modest 206,000 barrels per day (bpd) in April, opting for a cautious supply increase even as the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran disrupts shipments across the Middle East. The decision, confirmed in an official statement after the group’s meeting, involves eight core members: Saudi Arabia, Russia, the UAE, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria and Oman. item.description: For decades, the West has been sleepwalking into dependency. Today, China controls 95% of the world’s rare earth processing capacity…a leverage point so powerful, it could cripple Western economies in a matter of months. item.description: Following the escalation of the conflict in the Middle East, energy analysts and investment banks expect oil prices to surge this week to $90 with chances of hitting $100 per barrel if disruptions to traffic in the crucial Strait of Hormuz persist.
